description: This file defines the Language controller class for the OpenCart system, handling language selection and saving language preferences, including generating URLs for language switching and managing language data.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing language selection and persistence in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the language selection interface, prepares language data, and builds the URL for switching languages.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the request to change the language, updates session data, and redirects the user appropriately.
